entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data contain the complete epistle body at line 28, independently maintained as a derived comparison witness. Nine word positions differ accidentally from the selected printed reading; no inherited text is expanded.

The cited Benziger 1962 (Editio iuxta typicam) page prints the complete 132-word epistle body, Romans 6:3–11 with Fratres, without shared expansions. The announcement and scripture reference are outside the standalone reading.
